source: NASA Exoplanet Archive hosts grouped with AT-HYG/HYG companions (D32–D36)
recordFormat: One solar system per record. Stars list their own planetIds; circumbinaryPlanets orbit the barycenter of starIds. Archive-host and hyg-companion stars carry links only (position and physics are re-derived from exoplanet-hosts.json / exoplanet-hyg-stars.json); the system positionPc is its primary star. synthesized stars carry full approximate physics. existing: true marks systems already in the curated catalog.
